short_description: Calculate monthly savings from income and expenses.

files.content:
Budget Snapshot

Local demo: calculations stay in this browser and no provider or network call runs.

Savings: $0
No breakdown yet.
No recommendation yet.

function money(n){return '$'+Math.round(n).toLocaleString();}function calculateBudget(){const income=Number(document.getElementById('budget-income').value)||0;const rent=Number(document.getElementById('budget-rent').value)||0;const food=Number(document.getElementById('budget-food').value)||0;const expenses=rent+food;const savings=income-expenses;document.getElementById('budget-savings').textContent='Savings: '+money(savings);document.getElementById('budget-breakdown').textContent='Income: '+money(income)+' | Rent: '+money(rent)+' | Food: '+money(food)+' | Expenses: '+money(expenses);document.getElementById('budget-recommendation').textContent=savings>0?'Put part of the surplus into a weekly buffer.':'Cut one flexible expense before adding new commitments.';}function resetBudget(){document.getElementById('budget-income').value='';document.getElementById('budget-rent').value='';document.getElementById('budget-food').value='';calculateBudget();}document.getElementById('budget-run').addEventListener('click',calculateBudget);document.getElementById('budget-reset').addEventListener('click',resetBudget);calculateBudget();

# Budget Snapshot

Run `python3 -m http.server 8080` and open `index.html`.

All calculations happen locally. This is a browser-only demo, not provider-backed financial advice.

# Test Plan

- Open the app.
- Change income and expense numbers.
- Click Calculate Budget.
- Confirm savings, breakdown, and recommendation update.

test_instructions: Change the numbers, calculate, and confirm the budget result updates locally.
